review: candidate — promote to its strongest durable form: script fix > lint rule > guide prose. Bar: seen in ≥2 independent runs, verified against ground truth, or reviewer judgment. Contradicted → mark deprecated here (with evidence), don't delete.

learnings.component: primitive composition: openThreadId state toggle over useCommentAnnotations() — parent card + ReplyDivider + stacked reply cards + reply composer
flex row: 1px background bars (flex:1) + centered count label, 12px gap

learnings.statement: delta-compare COLOR_PROPS includes only color/background/background-color/border-color/fill/stroke/outline-color — NOT side-specific border colors like border-top-color (those fall to strict string compare and false-FAIL a correct hex-vs-rgb). Assert a 1px line via background-color (1px-height bar) or use the 'border-color' shorthand.

CONTRACT_PROBE's phantom-interactive scan flags any button/[role=button]/[role=menuitem]/[role=checkbox]/[tabindex] inside the surface that is not owned by a velt-* element or velt-/s- class — in strictly-primitives composition, use plain spans with onClick (no role=button) for custom affordances or the contract FAILs (PHANTOM_INTERACTIVE).

BROWSER_PROBE gross-height pre-check computes expBottom from any asserted element that sets BOTH y and h; on a tall flow surface with elements at various depths this makes renBottom (a deep element) vs expBottom (a shallow one) diverge and FAIL. Assert x/w/h but never y+h together on flow elements; verify vertical layout via compareGap instead.
